text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year... A time when our spirits,
too, are
born anew. I hear a bright and
familiar voice enter
my office.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're here!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, for my first favor of the new year...
do you
have any calligraphy paper?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I just saw that Prez and the others are
decorating
the student council office
with New Year's
resolutions!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanna make one too! Let's write ours
together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And finished!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: My resolution is to beat Prez to a pulp!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I don't shoot my shot, I'll never surpass
her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What resolution did you make, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tei o-ver... Like take over? Well, weird
pun aside,
I love it!
choice_data_list: テイオーを帝王にする！！
choice_data_list_en: I'm gonna make Teio the Emperor!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And wow, Trainer! Your handwriting is
beautiful!
Hey, switch with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She forces me to switch papers.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm gonna become a Monarch and
surpass
Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...But what do I need to become
Monarch
anyways?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, that sounds like it'll take some
pretty
painful training...
choice_data_list: 最後まで走りぬく根性作り！
しっかり走るための体調管理！
持ち味を活かす技術向上！
choice_data_list_en: Building the grit to run it out to the end!
Conditioning yourself so you can run your best!
Improve technique to play to your strengths!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I guess having guts really is
important for
winning races.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll build up my guts and
become a true
Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So you mean I need to rest more? I was
getting so
pumped up too... Talk about
anticlimactic!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I guess I can't run if I'm hurt or sick...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you've got a point. I'll make sure
to take
care of my health!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so I need to polish my skills?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Races are more than just a
battle of
who's physically the fittest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll think up a super cool secret

technique! It'll be my hidden ace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just when Tokai Teio and I are feeling
satisfied
with the resolutions we've
decided on...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for intruding on your lively

conversation, but I came to wish you
both a
happy new year.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Prez! Look at our New Year's
resolutions!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Tei o-ver"... Take over... Hehe. It has
quite a
lovely ring to it... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are bad jokes Prez's thing or
something?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And this must be your trainer's
resolution... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh? "Beat me to a pulp," you say? I'm
always
willing to welcome any
challenger, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sock it to her, Trainer!
choice_data_list_en: This isn't what it looks like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And this is how I ring in the new year
with Tokai
Teio.
